items.problem: SDK-sample source uses a fixed `namespace SDKTemplate` with `x:Class="SDKTemplate.MainPage"` while `dotnet new winui -n <ProjectName>` scaffolds App/MainWindow under the project namespace; the mismatch produces CS0246 'MainPage' + WMC0909/WMC1111/WMC1509 XAML type-resolution errors that misleadingly look like an x:Bind/DataType bug.
items.evidence: build-events.jsonl lines 16628/16630 (CS0246 MainPage; WMC0909 Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario; WMC1111; WMC1509). lessons.json dev_agent_struggles[0]: agent theorized about x:DataType/LocalAssembly for several turns before finding the namespace mismatch.
items.root_cause: The skill's SDK-sample guidance never warns that Windows-Universal-Samples hard-code `namespace SDKTemplate`, so the dev-agent could not recognize the CS0246+WMC signature as a namespace mismatch.
items.change: Added a '### SDK-sample `SDKTemplate` namespace mismatch' subsection to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md (immediately before the SDK-sample NavigationView+Frame section) documenting the SDKTemplate convention, the exact CS0246+WMC0909/WMC1111/WMC1509 symptom signature, and the two valid reconciliations (keep SDKTemplate + add `using SDKTemplate;` to scaffold App/MainWindow, or rename consistently).
items.expected_effect: On a re-run of any SDK-sample migration, the agent recognizes the CS0246-on-MainPage + WMC cascade as a namespace mismatch and reconciles it in one step instead of spending several turns theorizing about x:Bind/LocalAssembly.
items.falsifiable_check: In a future SDK-sample trial log, the CS0246/WMC0909 cascade is resolved by a namespace reconciliation within one diagnostic turn (no multi-turn x:DataType/LocalAssembly theorizing), or the errors do not recur at all.
items.devils_advocate: Tier 1 (bootstrap script auto-reconcile) was considered but rejected: choosing whether to unify on SDKTemplate vs the project name, and how to touch scaffold-generated files, is a judgment call that the bulk-rewrite bootstrap should not force; a prose pattern the agent can apply is the right tier. Ignore test: if ignored the CS0246+WMC cascade recurs, but the symptom signature makes the note high-signal.

items.problem: A DataTemplate using x:Bind must declare x:DataType (WMC1111); the x:Bind section did not state this.
items.evidence: build-events.jsonl line 16628 'error WMC1111: DataTemplates containing x:Bind need a DataType to be specified using x:DataType'.
items.root_cause: The '`x:Bind` and compiled bindings' section covered x:Bind generally but omitted the DataTemplate x:DataType requirement and did not connect a WMC0909 'unresolvable DataType' to the namespace-mismatch cause.
items.change: Added two sentences to the existing '`x:Bind` and compiled bindings' section: DataTemplates using x:Bind require `x:DataType`, the DataType must resolve via `local:`, and a present-but-unresolvable DataType (WMC0909) points to the SDKTemplate namespace mismatch (cross-linked).
items.expected_effect: Agent adds/keeps x:DataType on item templates and does not misdiagnose WMC0909 as a template bug.
items.falsifiable_check: Future trials show WMC1111 resolved by adding x:DataType (not by editing bindings), and WMC0909 routed to the namespace fix.
items.devils_advocate: Redundancy: the section existed but omitted this; this sharpens existing content rather than adding a new topic. Prose is the only feasible tier — the compiler already emits the code, but its message is opaque about the SDKTemplate root cause.

deferred_to_human: Test-AppLaunch.ps1 only probes the bin\x64\Debug output layout; a bare `dotnet build` (no -p:Platform=x64) lands binaries under bin\Debug\<tfm>\win-x64 and the launcher reports 'no build output'. SKILL.md Step 3 already prescribes `winapp build`, so this is a dev-agent slip, not applied here — but if bare dotnet build becomes common, consider teaching Test-AppLaunch.ps1 to also probe bin\Debug\<tfm>\win-x64.
